title.en: Life as a condition of life

statement.zh: 形成与条件是一个关系项的两种角色；体现的关系项作为条件，并经由另一个活跃者的给予而生起。
statement.en: Formations and conditions are two roles of one relatum; an embodied relatum is a condition, and it arises through another's giving.

laws.zh: 把依存网与流读作一类关系项：一个形成在零水平上作为条件，没有谁依存、汲取、从它取用或向它给予；一个条件从不活跃，不依存、不汲取、不取用也不给予。
laws.en: Read with one kind of relatum, a formation stands at level zero as a condition, and nothing depends on it, draws on it, takes from it or gives to it; a condition is never active, and depends on, draws on, takes from and gives to nothing.

laws.zh: 这样读，依存网保持支持、Dependent、条件的更新与消耗、形成的类、侵蚀、逐步读法中活的事件、生起、不息生成与活跃形成的普查。
laws.en: So read, a web keeps support, Dependent, the renewal and consumption of conditions, the classes of formations, undermining, the living events of the stepwise reading, arising, unceasing generation and a census of the active formations.

laws.zh: 流这样读保持取用与给予、平衡、Acting、Taking、present 不重复、家族的取用者与补充者、不止地更多与耗散；共同参与与相互作用两种估值的连通不变。
laws.en: A flow so read keeps what is taken and given, balance, Acting, Taking, present without repetition, the takers and renewers of a family, more without end and dissipation; the co-participation and interaction valuations keep their connection.

laws.zh: 一个关系项体现，当它恰在活跃时以正的水平作为条件而在；它承担自身，当它活跃时以正的需要依存于自身的水平。在 Dependent 之下，承担自身的关系项活跃时作为条件而在，体现时它对自身的依存恰在它活跃时被满足。
laws.en: A relatum is embodied when it stands as a condition at a positive level exactly while it is active; it bears on itself when, while active, it depends on its own level at a positive need. Under Dependent a relatum bearing on itself stands as a condition while active, and if it is embodied its self-dependence is met exactly while it is active.

laws.zh: 依存网与流的一类读法中，曾活跃的形成既不体现也不承担自身。
laws.en: In the one-kind reading of webs and flows, no formation active at some step is embodied or bears on itself.

laws.zh: 一类的依存网本身就是两个索引类型相同的两类网；一类读法另加的是条件 x 与形成 x 是同一个关系项，这由共同的索引给出。把条件一侧满射地重新标号，Dependent、侵蚀、活的事件与两种估值的连通都不变，而体现与承担自身改变。
laws.en: A one-kind web is itself a two-kind web whose index types coincide; what the one-kind reading adds is that condition x and formation x are one relatum, which the shared index supplies. Relabelling the condition side onto itself keeps Dependent, undermining, the living events and the connection of both valuations, and changes which relata are embodied and bear on themselves.

laws.zh: 在 Dependent 之下，以正需要依存于体现关系项的形成只在该关系项活跃时活跃；活动沿每条这样的依存链传递，所以一个在某步不活跃的关系项在该步终结每个依存链到达它的形成。在需要为一时消耗体现的关系项就是终结它。
laws.en: Under Dependent, a formation depending on an embodied relatum at a positive need is active only while that relatum is; activity passes along every chain of such dependence, so a relatum not active at a step ends there every formation whose chain reaches it. Consuming an embodied relatum at a need of one ends it.

laws.zh: 在 Dependent 之下，在承担自身的体现关系项终结之步汲取它，断裂它自身的依存，不论是什么终结了它，也不论是否另有形成依存于它，所以该汲取事件不是 living：不取用的旁观者在花因自身的取用而凋之步汲取它，以及花自己的最后事件，都是如此。
laws.en: Under Dependent, drawing on an embodied relatum that bears on itself, across the step at which it ends, breaks its own dependence whatever ends it and whether or not any other formation depends on it, so the drawing event is not living: a bystander that takes nothing, drawing on a flower as it wilts by its own taking, and the flower's own last event are such events.

laws.zh: 在只有活跃形成给予的平衡流中，体现的关系项只经由另一个活跃形成的给予而生起。给予它的形成不必体现、承担自身或依存于任何东西；只有体现的关系项给予时（表示所给的前提），它也体现，而这样的形成可以是只以水平作为条件而在、不依存于任何东西的源。
laws.en: In a balanced flow in which only active formations give, an embodied relatum arises only as another active formation gives to it. The formation that gives need not be embodied, bear on itself or depend on anything; where only embodied relata give, a supplied premise, it is embodied too, as a source standing as a condition and depending on nothing can be.

laws.zh: 经由另一者的给予而生起在一步之内成立：该步在含此关系项的家族上平衡、它在该步两端体现、只有活跃形成给予它，就够了；只有活跃形成给予的平衡流中的形式是其推论。
laws.en: Arising through another's giving holds within one step: balance across the step on a family holding the relatum, its embodiment at the two ends of the step and only active formations giving to it suffice, and the form for a balanced flow in which only active formations give is the corollary.

laws.zh: 汲取承担自身的关系项，与它的每个活跃事件相互作用：蜜蜂与花各自依存于自身与对方并汲取对方，彼此更新，每个事件都是 living，没有第三个条件，相互作用读法就连通，生生之意义在那里恰为种子加两项中立。
laws.en: Drawing on a relatum that bears on itself interacts with each of its active events: a bee and a flower, each depending on itself and on the other and drawing on the other, renew each other, every event is living, and with no third condition the interaction reading is connected, so that living significance there is exactly a seed with both neutralities.

laws.zh: 各自只依存于对方时，两者都体现，共同参与与相互作用仍不把蜜蜂与花关联起来：体现本身不进入估值。
laws.en: Where each depends only on the other, both are embodied and still neither co-participation nor interaction relates the bee to the flower: embodiment itself does not enter the valuations.

laws.zh: 狐依存于它汲取的兔，随兔一同终结，它在兔终结之步的汲取断裂兔自身的依存；一代代形成不止地生起，每一代由前一代给予。
laws.en: A fox depending on the hare it draws on ends with it, and its drawing across the step at which the hare ends breaks the hare's own dependence; generation after generation arises without end, each given by the one before.

hypotheses.zh: Embodied 与 SelfBearing 是对具体关系项的表示前提：遗骸在活动之后仍作为条件，水这样的条件在而不活跃，都不体现；哪些关系项体现、一个形成是否承担自身，是应用义务。
hypotheses.en: Embodied and SelfBearing are representational premises about particular relata: remains stand as conditions after activity ends, and a condition such as water stands without being active, so neither is embodied; which relata are embodied, and whether a formation bears on itself, are application duties.

hypotheses.zh: 一类读法的同一对应：条件 x 就是形成 x，由共同的索引类型给出。两类读法检查不到它（relabel）；对应用，哪个条件就是哪个形成是对应义务，与 Embodied 一样。
hypotheses.en: The one-kind identification: condition x is formation x, given by the shared index type. The two-kind readings do not check it (relabel); for an application, which condition is which formation is a correspondence duty, as Embodied is.

hypotheses.zh: Dependent：形成只在当下依存的条件支持时活跃（不含缓冲、储备与滞后）。
hypotheses.en: Dependent: a formation is active only where the conditions it then depends on support it (buffers, reserves and lags are left out).

hypotheses.zh: 体现的关系项经由另一个活跃者的给予而生起，需要流平衡依存网，并且只有活跃的形成给予（Acting）；给予它的关系项体现，另需只有体现的关系项给予；体现不等于是生命（EmbodiedSource）。
hypotheses.en: Arising through another's giving needs the flow to balance the web, and only active formations to give (Acting); that the relatum giving is embodied needs, in addition, that only embodied relata give; being embodied is not being a life (EmbodiedSource).

hypotheses.zh: 估值的结果用逐步读法的 living；相互作用是公开的对应纪律，不是展开的推论。
hypotheses.en: The valuation results use the stepwise reading of living; interaction is a disclosed correspondence discipline, not a consequence of the unfolding.

does_not_show.zh: Dependent 排除缓冲、储备、休眠与滞后，共灭在它们之下不必在同一步成立；沿依存链的滞后共灭见 reserve-defers-ending。
does_not_show.en: Dependent leaves out buffers, reserves, dormancy and lags, under which coextinction need not hold at the same step; lagged coextinction along chains of dependence is stated in reserve-defers-ending.

does_not_show.zh: 一类读法保持的是列出的读法（Acting、Taking、普查、present 不重复与耗散在内），不是每个陈述的读法。
does_not_show.en: The one-kind reading keeps the listed readings (Acting, Taking, a census, present without repetition and dissipation among them), not every stated reading.

does_not_show.zh: Brood 只给予不取用，不耗散；耗散之下的一类读法见 generation-is-replenishment。
does_not_show.en: Brood gives without taking and is not dissipative; the one-kind reading under dissipation is in generation-is-replenishment.

does_not_show.zh: 终结之步的汲取读的是与终结的同时，不读因果；在逐步读法下，这样的汲取对每个汲取者都不 living，这一判定不是对汲取者的估值。
does_not_show.en: Drawing at an ending is read as co-occurrence with the ending, not as causation; on the stepwise reading such drawing is not living, for every drawer, and that verdict is no valuation of the drawer.

does_not_show.zh: 给予生起的体现关系项者不必体现。
does_not_show.en: The relatum that gives to an arising embodied relatum need not be embodied.

does_not_show.zh: 只有体现的关系项给予时，给予的体现关系项不必是生命：体现表示的是作为条件而在。
does_not_show.en: Where only embodied relata give, the embodied relatum that gives need not be a life: being embodied represents standing as a condition.

detail.zh: 不承担自身时，直接的关系看不见：Mutualism.apart 中蜜蜂与花各自只依存于对方，共同参与与相互作用都不连通（apart_not_connected、apart_not_interacting），尽管两者都体现（apart_embodied）：估值只经由共同的条件关联事件，体现本身不进入估值，只有承担自身把体现的关系项的活动接到汲取它的事件上。
detail.en: Without self-bearing the direct relation is invisible: in Mutualism.apart, where each of the bee and the flower depends only on the other, neither co-participation nor interaction connects them (apart_not_connected, apart_not_interacting), though both are embodied (apart_embodied): the valuations relate events only through a shared condition, so embodiment itself does not enter them, and only a self-dependence ties the embodied relatum's activity to the events drawing on it.

detail.zh: 两类读法中曾活跃的形成既不体现也不承担自身（roles_not_embodied、roles_not_selfBearing）；两类表示省略的是形成与条件的同一对应，体现与承担自身是在这一对应下的读法：把条件一侧满射地重新标号，两类读法不变，体现与承担自身改变（relabel_dependent、relabel_undermining、Mutualism.apart_relabelled、Wilting.relabelled_not_embodied）。
detail.en: In the two-kind reading no formation active at some step is embodied or bears on itself (roles_not_embodied, roles_not_selfBearing); what the two-kind representation omits is the identification of formations with conditions, under which embodiment and bearing on oneself are read: relabelling the condition side onto itself keeps the two-kind readings and changes embodiment and self-bearing (relabel_dependent, relabel_undermining, Mutualism.apart_relabelled, Wilting.relabelled_not_embodied).

detail.zh: 前提相容并且结论可达：Brood 平衡、Acting、Dependent，每代体现并承担自身，生成不息；Predation 中狐在兔终结之步的汲取是断裂，狐随兔终结。
detail.en: The premises are consistent and the conclusions attained: Brood balances, is Acting and Dependent, each generation is embodied and bears on itself, and generation is unceasing; in Predation the fox's drawing across the step at which the hare ends is breaking and the fox ends with the hare.

detail.zh: ending_breaks 读的是与终结的同时：花因自身的取用而凋，从不取用的蜜蜂在那一步的汲取仍是断裂并侵蚀，花自己的最后事件也是（Wilting.wilting）。在 Dependent 与体现之下，对自身的依存恰在活跃时被满足（SelfBearing.met_iff）。
detail.en: ending_breaks reads co-occurrence with the ending: the flower wilts by its own taking, and the bee, which never takes, still breaks and undermines when it draws at that step, as does the flower's own last event (Wilting.wilting). Under Dependent and embodiment, a self-dependence is met exactly while the relatum is active (SelfBearing.met_iff).

detail.zh: arises_given 中给予的关系项只是一个活跃的关系项：不体现、不承担自身、不依存于任何东西的源可以是唯一给予的关系项（SourceSeed.source_gives）。
detail.en: The relatum giving in arises_given is an active relatum, not a life: a source that is not embodied, does not bear on itself and depends on nothing can be the only relatum that gives (SourceSeed.source_gives).

detail.zh: arises_from_embodied 的全部前提成立而它命名一个源（EmbodiedSource.embodied_source）：源的水平取一，体现，作为条件而在并给予种子；它不需要、不汲取、不取用任何东西，也不承担自身。体现是对作为条件而在的表示，不是对是生命的表示。
detail.en: Every premise of arises_from_embodied holds and it names a source (EmbodiedSource.embodied_source): with its level set to one the source is embodied, stands as a condition and gives to the seed; it requires, draws on and takes nothing and does not bear on itself. Being embodied represents standing as a condition, not being a life.

next_delta.zh: 说明遗骸与形成的跨步关系；以反事实关系读“汲取终结了它”；说明体现关系项作为条件与“更多”的关系。
next_delta.en: Relate remains, across steps, to the formation whose remains they are; read “the drawing ends it” through a counterfactual relation; relate embodied relata as conditions to “more”.

correspondence.zh: Web 与 Flow 把形成与条件分为两类，省略了“生作为生的条件”：父母与后代、森林与林下、群落与学习者，只能经由代理条件表示。按非二元方法（先说明同一生成展开中的关系，再说明行动者与承受者怎样在其中分化），本结果把形成与条件读作一个关系项的两种角色；一类读法另需哪个条件就是哪个形成的对应，是表示的前提。Ren 的原话是“生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向”。作者把“体现的关系项作为条件”与“体现的关系项经由另一个活跃者的给予而生起”读作原话中两个“生”之间关系的一种形式内容：第二个“生”（生起）由另一个活跃者的给予给出（AI 论证）。把体现的关系项读作“生”是 AI 读法，依 Ren 的交托采用（DELEGATED-CHOICES D4）；它不替代 Ren 的原话，也不推出它是好的。在逐步读法下，终结之步的汲取对每个汲取者都不 living，这一判定不估值任何汲取者；进程是否更差由可能性的比较决定（DELEGATED-CHOICES D6）。新名称按 Ren 的命名规则采用（DELEGATED-CHOICES D36）。
correspondence.en: Web and Flow split formations and conditions into two kinds, omitting life as a condition of life (parents and young, a forest and its understory, a community and its learners), representable only through a proxy condition. Following the nondual method (relations in one becoming first, then how actors and patients differentiate within them), this result reads formations and conditions as two roles of one relatum; the one-kind reading needs in addition the correspondence of which condition is which formation, a premise of the representation. Ren's words are “生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向” (a whole direction of unceasingly creating more 生). The author reads an embodied relatum as a condition, and its arising through another's giving, as one formal content of the relation between the two 生 of those words: the second 生, arising, is given by another active relatum's giving (an AI argument). Reading embodied relata as 生 is an AI reading, adopted on Ren's delegation (DELEGATED-CHOICES D4); it does not replace Ren's words and does not show that it is good. On the stepwise reading drawing at an ending is not living, for every drawer, a verdict that values no drawer; whether a course is worse is for the comparison on possibilities (DELEGATED-CHOICES D6). The new names are adopted under Ren's naming rule (DELEGATED-CHOICES D36).

detail.zh: 复用依存网、支持、Dependent、更新、消耗、形成的类、断裂与侵蚀；一类读法保持它们。
detail.en: Reuses webs, support, Dependent, renewal, consumption, the classes of formations, breaking and undermining; the one-kind reading keeps them.

input.zh: 一类关系项的读法与体现关系项上的结论。
input.en: The one-kind reading and conclusions on embodied relata.

conditions.zh: Dependent（只用于体现关系项上的结论）。
conditions.en: Dependent (only for the conclusions on embodied relata).

detail.zh: 复用流、平衡、Acting、取用者、补充者与 More；arises_given 用 Balances.renewedBy。
detail.en: Reuses flows, balance, Acting, takers, renewers and More; arises_given uses Balances.renewedBy.

output.zh: 平衡的流中每次上升由活跃的补充者造成。
output.en: In a balanced flow every rise is made by an active renewer.

input.zh: 体现关系项的生起由另一个活跃形成给予。
input.en: An embodied relatum's arising is given by another active formation.

detail.zh: 复用相互作用的纪律与估值；连通的结果陈述在 Becoming.Correspondence 新增的一节。
detail.en: Reuses the interaction discipline and its valuation; the connection results are stated in a new section of Becoming.Correspondence.

input.zh: 一类读法下连通不变；承担自身的形成直接相关。
input.en: Connection kept under the one-kind reading; formations bearing on themselves relate directly.

detail.zh: Mutualism.significant_iff 用 G0 的刻画 Valuation.significant_iff。

output.zh: 连通整体上 G0 的刻画。
output.en: G0's characterization on a connected whole.

input.zh: 互利见证上 G0 恰为种子加两项中立。
input.en: On the mutualism witness G0 is exactly a seed with both neutralities.

detail.zh: Brood 满足体现、承担自身与 Acting，并且生成不息；生起与不息在一类读法中保持。
detail.en: Brood meets embodiment, self-bearing and Acting, and generation is unceasing; arising and unceasing generation are kept by the one-kind reading.

detail.zh: Brood 只给予不取用，不耗散（Brood.not_dissipative）；耗散之下的一类读法见 generation-is-replenishment。
detail.en: Brood gives without taking and is not dissipative (Brood.not_dissipative); the one-kind reading under dissipation is in generation-is-replenishment.

detail.zh: 遗骸若表示为另一关系项，其与原形成的关系是跨步同一的问题。
detail.en: If remains are represented as another relatum, their relation to the formation is a question of identity across steps.

detail.zh: 非二元方法：形成与条件是同一展开中的角色，两类表示可以嵌入一类读法，同一对应由共同的索引给出。整体的演绎仍开放。
detail.en: Nondual method: formations and conditions are roles in one unfolding, and the two-kind representation embeds in the one-kind reading, with the identification supplied by the shared index. The whole deduction remains open.

detail.zh: 体现的关系项的生起就是补充；在耗散之下，体现的生成复现的有限家族须与其外交换。该结果把本结果的生起经由给予推进为数量与耗散的形式。
detail.en: The arising of an embodied relatum is replenishment; under dissipation a finite family in which embodied generation recurs must exchange beyond itself. That result carries this one's arising through giving on to amounts and dissipation.

detail.zh: 在一类读法中给出两种直接的 related：以之为生使只依存于对方的蜂与花相关（Mutualism.apart），世系使各由前一代给予的世代连通（Brood）。
detail.en: Gives two direct readings of related in the one-kind reading: living on relates the bee and the flower that depend only on each other (Mutualism.apart), and descent connects generations each given by the one before (Brood).

detail.zh: Web.Embodied.arises_given 改为 Flow.BalancesOn.arises_given 的推论：一步两端都体现、只有活跃者给予它的关系项，生起恰当开始立着，由一个不是它自己的活跃给予者给予。这是证明上的复用；记录之间不设依存边，因为 laws-of-one-step 复用的基础记录经 generation-is-replenishment 依存于本记录。
detail.en: Web.Embodied.arises_given is re-proved as a corollary of Flow.BalancesOn.arises_given: a relatum embodied at both ends of the step and given to only by active formations arises exactly when it comes to stand, as an active giver other than itself gives to it. This is reuse in the proof; no dependency edge joins the records, since the base records laws-of-one-step reuses depend on this one through generation-is-replenishment.

history.en: 2026-10-09: added as P14 of the unification plan, answering H14 of the fourth independent review (splitting formations and conditions into two kinds omits life as a condition of life); following Ren's “move on to pursue the theory of becoming, and prove the necessary proofs”.

history.en: 2026-10-09: P16b integrates the sixth independent review (J4–J8, J11): the title's “life given by life” becomes “embodied arising through another's giving”; the one-kind identification is a premise of the representation (relabel); embodiment does not enter the valuations (apart_embodied); ending_breaks is co-occurrence with an ending (Wilting, SelfBearing.met_iff); the giver need not be a life (SunSeed, with arises_from_embodied); the one-kind reading also keeps Acting, Taking, a census, present without repetition and dissipation; Brood.costless is renamed Brood.not_dissipative; the existing theorems and proofs are unchanged.

history.zh: 2026-10-09：P16c 整合第七次独立审查（K6、K8(c)）：arises_from_embodied 证明的是“只有体现的关系项给予时，给予它的关系项体现”，其中的关系项可以是不依存于任何东西的太阳（EmbodiedSun）；对应不再说“生由生”已证明，把体现读作“生”属于 Ren；假设名 givers 改为 gives_embodied，“给予者”改为“给予它的关系项”；原有定理与证明不变。
history.en: 2026-10-09: P16c integrates the seventh independent review (K6, K8(c)): arises_from_embodied proves that where only embodied relata give, the relatum that gives is embodied, and that relatum may be a sun depending on nothing (EmbodiedSun); the correspondence no longer says that “life from life” is proved, reading embodiment as 生 being Ren's; the hypothesis givers is renamed gives_embodied, and “giver” becomes “the relatum that gives”; the existing theorems and proofs are unchanged.
